messages:
Jess: Quick Q — I'm starting offboarding next week. If I do a rollover from my 401(k) to an IRA, will the plan vendor withhold taxes automatically? Worried about the 20% withholding and timing with my last paycheck.

Emily (People Ops): Short answer: depends on transfer type. Trustee-to-trustee transfer (direct rollover) = no withholding. If they cut you a distribution payable to you, gov't requires 20% mandatory withholding on an eligible rollover distribution. We can request direct rollover form from the vendor.

Jess: Ok got it. My plan had both 'direct rollover to IRA' and 'check made payable to employee' options. If it gets 20% withheld but I complete rollover within 60 days, can I get it back?

Ben: You can roll over the gross amount within 60 days to avoid taxes, but you'll have to come up with the withheld 20% out of pocket when you do the rollover, otherwise the withheld amount is considered distribution and taxable + possible early withdrawal penalty. Also if you're doing a conversion to Roth IRA, that's a taxable event — withholding won't cover the tax bill necessarily.

Samir: Also note: if you elect a direct trustee-to-trustee to a Roth IRA (in-plan Roth conversion?), converting pretax 401k to Roth is taxable. Confirm with vendor if they do in-plan Roth.

Emily (People Ops): I'll ping the vendor and attach the direct-rollover checklist. @Jess — if you want, I can set the form to 'trustee-to-trustee' and include 'Rollover to Traditional IRA' so no withholding. If you prefer Roth conversion we'll include the 'tax withholding authorization' but you'll need to plan for taxes.

HR Bot: Reminder: vendor contact — Fidelity 1-800-XXX-0000; online form: https://fidelity.example/rollover (use 'direct rollover' option).

Jess: Thanks! One more: does doing a rollover after my termination affect company match vesting? I'm fully vested but want to double-check.

Emily (People Ops): If you're fully vested, rolling over doesn't affect it. If not vested, vesting schedule applies prior to distribution date; since you're leaving, final vesting is per plan rules. I can confirm your vesting % — LMK.

Ben: Also FYI: HSA remains yours — you can keep contributing only if you have an HSA-eligible health plan. FSA is use-it-or-lose-it per plan; COBRA may apply to health FSA.

Jess: Perfect, thanks. Emily, please confirm vendor will send direct-transfer instructions and any deadlines tied to offboarding payroll.

Emily (People Ops): Will do. I'll follow up in this thread after I hear back from Fidelity. :thumbsup:

HR Bot: Status update (automated): Ticket #PO-4821 created with Fidelity; expected reply 2 business days.

Emily (People Ops): Fidelity confirmed: direct rollover form accepted, set 'payable to trustee' and return. No withholding for trustee-to-trustee. I'll upload the PDF to the offboarding folder.
